# Conservation (CON)

How long issued invoices and their records are kept, by whom, and what to export before changing systems.

Rules page: https://docs.beel.es/rules/conservation

"Checked by: Your integration" or "The issuing business" means BeeL. does not enforce the rule, beyond any error codes it lists: the integration has to.

## Contents

- [CON-001](#con-001) — Keep copies of issued invoices for the limitation period
- [CON-002](#con-002) — AEAT keeps the records, not your invoices
- [CON-003](#con-003) — Export your invoices and records before leaving
- [CON-004](#con-004) — Invoices kept electronically are reachable on request

## CON-001

**Keep copies of issued invoices for the limitation period**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: high · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

The issuing business keeps copies of the invoices it issues, with their original content and in order, for the limitation period of the General Tax Law: at least four years from the filing deadline, and longer in some cases.

**Why:** AEAT can ask for any invoice within that period. Keeping copies is the issuer's duty even when someone else keeps them materially.

**Applies to:** Every issued invoice.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 19.2 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a19
- Ley 37/1992 del IVA, art. 165.Uno — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1992-28740#a165
- Ley 58/2003 General Tributaria, art. 66 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2003-23186#a66
- Código de Comercio, art. 30.1 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1885-6627#art30

**Incorrect:** Assuming invoices can be discarded once the quarter is filed.

**Correct:** Keeping every issued invoice, PDF and data, for the whole period, in order.

**Related:** CON-002, CON-003, CON-004

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/compliance-and-responsibilities#what-beel-keeps-for-each-invoice

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CON-001.md

## CON-002

**AEAT keeps the records, not your invoices**

`MUST` · AEAT criterion · Impact: medium · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Under VERI*FACTU AEAT keeps the billing records, but a record does not contain the whole invoice: its lines, for one, are not in it. Keep the full invoices yourself.

**Why:** Relying on AEAT's copy leaves you without the detail of each invoice when you are asked for it.

**Applies to:** Invoices of a company under VeriFactu.

**Legal basis:**

- AEAT, Aclaraciones a dudas de los desarrolladores (v1.3), 13. Conservación de registros en VERI*FACTU y libros registros — https://www.agenciatributaria.es/static_files/AEAT_Desarrolladores/EEDD/IVA/VERI-FACTU/FAQs-Desarrolladores.pdf

**Incorrect:** Keeping only the AEAT registration numbers and discarding the invoices.

**Correct:** Keeping each invoice's PDF and data, lines included.

**Related:** CON-001, CON-003

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/compliance-and-responsibilities#what-beel-keeps-for-each-invoice

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CON-002.md

## CON-003

**Export your invoices and records before leaving**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

The issuing business must be able to reach its invoices and billing records for the whole conservation period, also after changing systems. Export the invoices, their PDFs and their records before closing the account.

**Why:** The duty to keep them does not end when the business stops using a system. What is not exported before closing is no longer at hand.

**Applies to:** operations `createCompanyInvoiceExport`, `createCompanyInvoicePdfArchive`, `listCompanyInvoiceVerifactuRecords`

**Legal basis:**

- Orden HAC/1177/2024, art. 8.3 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2024-22138#a8

**Incorrect:** Closing the account at the end of the year with no copy of that year's invoices.

**Correct:** Exporting the invoices and downloading their PDFs first.

```bash
curl -X POST "https://app.beel.es/api/v1/companies/{company_id}/invoices/exports" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BEEL_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "format": "ITEMS", "filters": { "date_from": "2026-01-01", "date_to": "2026-12-31" } }' \
  -o invoices-2026.xlsx
```

**Related:** CON-001, CON-004

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/bulk-operations-and-exports#exports

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CON-003.md

## CON-004

**Invoices kept electronically are reachable on request**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: low · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Invoices kept electronically must be available online, so that AEAT can view, download and use them on request without undue delay.

**Why:** Copies you cannot produce when AEAT asks count as copies you do not have.

**Applies to:** Invoices kept by electronic means.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 21.2 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a21

**Incorrect:** Archiving the invoices on a disk nobody can reach remotely.

**Correct:** Keeping them where they can be searched and downloaded when AEAT asks.

**Related:** CON-001, CON-003

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/bulk-operations-and-exports#exports

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CON-004.md
